tools.name: Claude Motion
tools.detail: /motion slash command in Claude; beta, limited access; builds animation as code from text, charts, images; export MP4

tools.name: Descript
tools.detail: Named as editing tool to open the export in

tools.name: Runway
tools.detail: Named as editing tool to open the export in

claims: Type /motion, attach a file, describe the output (e.g. 'turn this quarterly report into a 30 second explainer for our team meeting')
Claude builds the animation from your text, charts and images; plays like a real video
Not an AI video model: no fake footage, no AI-generated people; built as code so changing one word, number, or timing leaves everything else unchanged
Export as MP4 or open in editing tools (Descript, Runway)
Feature is in beta; not everyone has access
how_to_steps: Attach the source file (e.g. Q3-report.pdf, 12 pages)
Prompt: 'Turn this quarterly report into a 30-second explainer for our team meeting.'
Review the generated scenes; edit a word/number/timing (e.g. 'Revenue' -> 'Growth', 15% -> 18%, 2.0s -> 1.2s) and re-render
Export MP4 or hand off to Descript/Runway
on_screen_only: Video player 'claude-motion.mov': 'Introducing Claude Motion — Now in beta'
Composer: 'MESSAGE CLAUDE' with '/motion' chip and attached 'Q3-report.pdf PDF · 12 pages'
'YOUR PROMPT: Turn this quarterly report into a 30-second explainer for our team meeting.'
Output 'Q3-explainer.mp4' showing 'Q3 revenue +18%' bar chart animation
'AI VIDEO MODEL — NOT THIS' crossed-out card
Code panel 'animation.code': scene("intro", 0s -> 4s) title("Q3 revenue") number("+18%") bars([42, 58, 50, 86]) ease("spring", 0.6s) scene("growth", 4s -> 9s)
Edit cards: ONE WORD Revenue -> Growth; ONE NUMBER 15% -> 18%; THE TIMING 2.0s -> 1.2s
'Keep editing anywhere' MP4 -> two 'EDITING TOOL' boxes; 'Motion BETA' with locked user icons (limited access)

relevance.why: If real, a fast way for a time-poor founder to make product explainers, pitch/update videos and marketing clips from existing docs without video tooling. Beta-gated, so not usable immediately.

implement_score.why: Try /motion when it appears in our Claude account; use for app demo/explainer and investor/customer update videos. Until then, nothing to build; a Remotion/Motion-Canvas + Claude Code pipeline is the DIY equivalent.

verify: Does Claude Motion exist (Anthropic announcement), and is '/motion' the real invocation? The mock UI looks creator-made
